children: Moneyview Limited is a consumer-focused, digital only, credit-led financial services platform for Middle India customers, providing access to a full suite of financial products through a network of Financial Partners, including the company’s NBFC subsidiary. The company offers personalized financial products with responsible and transparent terms, delivered through a convenient and user-friendly digital experience. As of June 30, 2026, the company had 140.28 million Registered Users and 11.90 million Monetized Users, with its platform serving 99.04% of PIN codes across India. The company has built a large and growing user base through organic channels, embedded partnerships and digital marketing, with Registered Users increasing from 83.27 million as of March 31, 2024 to 134.14 million as of March 31, 2026.
